name: conventions
description: Opt-in coding conventions enforced as PreToolUse hooks: American English everywhere, and a git guard that blocks the writes which destroy work (bare force/deleting/mirroring push, reset --hard, restore, destructive checkout, clean -f, bulk staging, git mv/rm, plus interactive rebase, which has no editor to drive it) while allowing Claude to stage named paths, commit, amend, rebase, and push with a lease. Also ships a Windows-only no-null-redirect hook (not auto-wired, since it must not run on Unix). Enable this plugin to adopt Oire's opinionated conventions; they are organization policy rather than universal truths, so they live behind an explicit opt-in.
